name: AWS CloudTrail - Detect Permanent Key Creation

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail (CreateAccessKey IAMUser)
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name | where event_name="CreateAccessKey"
| parse "\"userIdentity\":{\"type\":\"*\"" as type | where type="IAMUser"
// EOQ

description: Monitor for accounts that create permanent keys. Permanent keys are not created by default and are only needed for programmatic calls.
